thread:
olivia: Sync request 1 - AurumBank is finalizing a large commit but needs a crisp capacity + compliance runbook before legal signs. They want: steady ~2M tokens/month, predictable spikes up to ~9-11k RPS for ~15-30m windows, p95 <=200ms, p99 <600ms, customer-managed KMS/HSM, and long-term audit retention. Can we produce a short presales playbook? cc @nikhil @maria @ajay @taylor @jenna

nikhil: Quick checklist: 1) steady reserve sizing, 2) predictable-burst plan (prewarm), 3) autoscale policy + coldstart expectations, 4) KV-cache warmup steps, 5) KMS/HSM + retention answers, 6) cost delta table.

maria: Are the spike windows scheduled or event-driven? If scheduled we can rely on short prewarm and smaller burst pool.

olivia: They said spikes are mostly scheduled (start of business day and nightly batch windows), but there are occasional ad-hoc spikes.

ajay: Recommendation sketch: reserve pool for base throughput (quantized int8 variant) sized to handle ~70-80% of expected peak QPS to optimize cost, plus a pre-warmed burst pool for scheduled windows that uses full-precision model for lowest latency. Autoscale policy should do local-AZ first then cross-AZ warm nodes, fallback to quantized model in case of spot eviction.

taylor: Preheat plan (ops): 1) T-30m: start prewarm nodes for target burst size; 2) T-15m: run KV-loader to load top-100 prefixes and last-1k sessions; 3) T-5m: synthetic ramp test at 60% target QPS for 5m; 4) shift canary traffic 10/50/100% during window with health checks. If eviction happens, route to quantized fallback in other AZ.

jenna: Compliance: we can support BYOK with HSM attestation (customer-managed keys), and export audit logs to a customer S3 bucket with server-side encryption. 7-year retention is doable but will be an add-on in the contract due to storage costs and legal obligations. I'll draft the questionnaire snippets.

ajay: Autoscale policy example (informal): policy: predictable-burst; steady_pool: 3 gpus (gptq-int8); burst_pool: 6 gpus (fp16), burst_prewarm_minutes:20; scale_triggers: queue_ms>150 or cpu/gpu_util>75% for 30s; fallback: cross-az-quantized. Expected coldstart to ramp to 80% in ~90-120s if prewarm not available; prewarm reduces this to ~10-20s.

maria: Cost guidance (rough): quantized steady path ~30-40% lower GPU compute cost vs fp16. Prewarm and reserved burst credits add ~5-12% to monthly run rate depending on prewarm duration. We'll produce per-sku numbers for A100/4090 variants tomorrow.

provision-bot: Reserve request created: pool_id=rb-9217 region=us-west-2 initial_nodes=3 burst_target=6 ETA provisioning ~40m.

olivia: Action items: @ajay final cost table + coldstart latency numbers by 10:00 PT tomorrow; @taylor write ops preheat + AZ-failover runbook; @jenna questionnaire draft and retention note; @nikhil assemble 1-page presales summary for customer. I'll schedule a 25-min review with AurumBank Thurs 11am PT. If security hits blockers we'll escalate to enterprise eng. Thanks all.
